summary: Train, evaluate, profile, and export TensorFlow models with Keras. Explore the 10-day practical course and review its curriculum.
lede: Deep Learning with TensorFlow and Keras training connects deep learning theory with practical AI model development. You will learn to design neural networks, use TensorFlow and Keras, optimize model performance, and interpret complex data patterns. The course also covers integrating AI into existing systems, automating workflows, and deploying models for real-world demands. It is designed to help professionals deliver capable AI solutions while managing limited resources, high complexity, and competing priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate practitioners who write Python code and work directly with neural-network training, evaluation, or deployment workflows.
prerequisites: Working Python knowledge and familiarity with basic machine-learning concepts are expected. Python coding is required for the practical model-building, training, evaluation, and export exercises.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
